subject: Post-demo pricing anchors and open-model host comparison
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Stella Reyes <stella@medly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: demo + quick ask on volume & target $/1M

Hi Stella — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and two asks so we can land a tight pilot proposal: 

Summary from our call:
- Use case: clinical decision support summaries for triage workflows (mixed short/long prompts).
- Expected daily traffic: 150k–300k requests initially, spiking to ~1.2M requests/day at scale.
- Avg tokens per request (estimate): 250 tokens (prompt + response); longer reports up to 2.5k tokens occasionally.
- Security: VPC + SOC2 in scope, will need audit/log retention for 12 months.

Asks:
1) Can you confirm a target budget range for inference per month (ballpark is fine) — e.g., $25k–$75k?
2) What target unit price (dollar per 1M tokens) would make a pilot viable from your side? If you have a target vs OpenAI/Anthropic benchmarks, please share.

We can put together a tiered price proposal showing: pilot discount, committed monthly volume bands, and a fallback host policy. I attached a short requirements sheet you mentioned (medly_requirements.pdf) for our internal alignment.

Next steps: if you confirm the budget range and a target $/1M, we’ll return a concise two-tab proposal (commercial + SLOs) by EOD next Tuesday.

Thanks — enjoyed the discussion.

— Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
redwood.ai

From: Stella Reyes <stella@medly.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Lin <d.lin@medly.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: demo + quick ask on volume & target $/1M

Priyom — thanks for the recap and the clear asks. Quick answers below: 

Budget: Current FY Q4 budget for pilots is ~$40k–50k for inference costs; we can stretch for a strong ROI case.
Target $/1M: We were benchmarking OpenAI and Anthropic at our side — rough target would be $15–$25 per 1M tokens to be competitive for this workload.

Important context:
- We will want to compare unit economics vs our existing OpenAI spend; if your platform can reduce cost by 30%+ at parity on latency and quality we have a strong path to expansion.
- We are also evaluating a host that offers quantization-backed throughput (open-host X) — curious how Redwood compares on a per-1M basis when you include caching and batching savings.

Can you provide a short benchmark that shows: OpenAI, Anthropic, Redwood-hosted baseline, and Redwood with batching/caching applied (projected $/1M)? If you can include expected p50/p95 latency at each tier that’d be helpful.

Happy to take a short call next week to walk through.

— Stella
Stella Reyes
Head of Digital Products, Medly Health
stella@medly.com

Attachment: medly_cost_snapshot.xls (referenced in body)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Medly — $/1M benchmarking draft (Q4)

Quick internal note and a draft benchmark attached (benchmarks_q4_v2.xlsx). High-level guidance I’d suggest we include in the customer-facing note: 

- Baseline host comparisons (all numbers are illustrative; see sheet for calc):
  * OpenAI (gpt-type) — $22–28 / 1M tokens (inc. avg latency ~120–180ms p50 for short prompts).
  * Anthropic (claude-type) — $24–30 / 1M tokens (latency similar; pricing slightly higher for long-context).
  * Open-host X (quantized) — $12–18 / 1M tokens but higher variance on latency and more ops overhead.
  * Redwood hosted (no batching/caching) — $18–23 / 1M tokens (SLA-backed).
  * Redwood optimized (batching + prefix/KV cache + quantization profile) — $9–14 / 1M tokens projected for Medly’s mix (250 avg tokens), with p50 latencies in the 80–150ms range depending on commit level.

- Negotiation levers: committed monthly volume, latency SLOs, data retention term, caching allowance, and fallback host acceptance.

- Recommendation: propose a tiered pilot with a 3-month ramp:
  1) Pilot tier (no commit): $18 / 1M tokens (proof-of-concept, short-term SLA)
  2) Pilot committed (3-month, 25k–100k/day avg): $13 / 1M tokens + 10% pilot credit back if uptime & quality targets met
  3) Committed expansion (6–12 month commit): $9–11 / 1M tokens depending on target volume and logging/retention terms

I put notes in the spreadsheet on assumptions (seq lengths, effective batching factor, % cache hit). Priyom/Laura — I can help refine numbers for the customer note.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (628) 555-0104

Attachment: benchmarks_q4_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Stella Reyes <stella@medly.com>
Cc: David Lin <d.lin@medly.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: demo + quick ask on volume & target $/1M

Stella — thanks for the quick numbers and context. I’ve pulled together a compact comparison and a proposed pricing anchor below (also shared Drive folder link). I’ll keep it short and action-focused.

Snapshot (projected $ per 1M tokens, Medly workload assumptions: avg 250 tokens/request, 1.2M req/day peak, caching hit 18%):
- OpenAI (observed): $24 / 1M (baseline)
- Anthropic (observed): $26 / 1M
- Open-host X (quantized): $15 / 1M (higher latency variance)
- Redwood (hosted, no optim): $19 / 1M
- Redwood (optimized: batching + KV cache + quantization profile): $11 / 1M (target for committed pilot)

Proposed pilot commercial (3 months):
- Option A — No commit (eval): $18 / 1M, up to $50k total spend cap
- Option B — Committed pilot (90-day, 150k avg/day): $12 / 1M with a $10k credit if SLA & quality gates are met
- Option C — Committed expansion (annual roll): $9 / 1M for >1.5B tokens/mo commit (custom SLA + priority routing)

Notes/assumptions:
- Latency p50/p95 with Redwood optimized projected at 85ms / 240ms for Medly’s mix; we’ll size inference fleet to meet p95 targets in the pilot contract.
- Savings assumptions include effective batching factor of 1.8x and ~18% prefix cache hit based on historical profiles for similar workflows.
- Any external host fallback or cross-host routing will be explicitly priced.

Next steps:
1) Confirm which pilot option you’d like us to price formally (A/B/C).
2) If Option B or C, confirm target committed daily volume band and desired retention/audit window.
3) We’ll share a 1‑pager commercial + SLA by Tue EOD with a DocuSign link for pilot acceptance.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleSharedDoc
DocuSign (coming): https://app.docusign.com/example/pilot-DEAL-8742

Looking forward to your preference — happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk the numbers.

Best,
— Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
